$comment: Canonical game roster. Fields are null or empty until sourced from the app listing itself - never invented. downloadFormat is APK because these are Android application packages; that is a property of the distribution type, not a per-app claim. Per-game 'features' and 'faqs' override the category defaults in category-content.json when populated. The build renders a field only when it holds a value.

categories.label: Rummy
categories.description: Card games built on the Indian rummy family, including 13-card and 21-card formats where players form valid sequences and sets.

categories.label: Slots & 777
categories.description: Reel-spinning and 777-style titles where the outcome turns on symbol combinations rather than player decisions.

categories.label: Teen Patti & VIP Club
categories.description: Teen Patti and private club-room titles, the three-card betting format widely played across India.

categories.label: Arcade & Casual
categories.description: Mixed-game hubs and casual titles that bundle several smaller games into a single app rather than specialising in one format.

categories.label: Multi-Game Platforms
categories.description: Multi-game platform apps that carry a broad catalogue spanning several of the other categories.

categories.label: Bingo
categories.description: Number-draw titles where players mark off numbers on a card as they are called, aiming to complete a winning pattern.

categories.label: Ludo & Board
categories.description: Board-game titles built on Ludo and related turn-based formats played on a cross-shaped track.
